properties.displayName: Deny PaaS resources with public network access enabled
properties.description: Refuses creation or update of supported PaaS resources whose publicNetworkAccess is not Disabled. Public access cannot be derived or safely auto-corrected, so it is denied rather than remediated. Covers Key Vault and Storage; Container Registry is intentionally absent because the registry was cut from this estate.

metadata.description: Deny blocks the deployment. Audit records it only.
